description: Primary-source evidence and conservative billing ceilings for Lightwork model pricing. Rates are USD per one million tokens.

entries.pricing_basis: USD per 1M tokens; maximum Standard context tier, 1.25x cache-write input ceiling, plus 10 percent regional-processing uplift
entries.applicability: Direct OpenAI Standard processing; conservative budget ceiling, not an actual invoice rate. Excludes Fast/priority premiums and Batch/Flex discounts.
